Timeless Strategist.brief: ASURYANI; start of battle round, bearer (or its Transport) on the battlefield: +1 Battle Focus token.

Tzeentch.brief: +3 A to this model's infernal cannon.

Vector of Disease#c7e572a04f.brief: While leading a unit: that unit's melee weapons have [Sustained Hits 1] and [Lance].

Warp-fuelled Thrusters#613a285951.brief: End of opponent's turn, if bearer's unit not in Engagement Range: remove it into Strategic Reserves.
